[0.00-1.80] FPV rapid push-in shot, a handsome young Asian male model with messy light brown hair, wearing a white shirt over a white t-shirt, standing against a clean modern minimalist studio background, looking directly into the camera with a bright, charming smile and gesturing with one finger raised to hook the audience, dynamic vertical framing, viral short-video pacing, soft commercial skin-glow lighting. Subtitle: "Hey guys! Want to level up your summer style instantly?"

[1.80-3.50] Cinematic close-up tracking shot, the young Asian male looking down thoughtfully with his hand gently touching his chin, showing a cool, contemplative expression, luxury studio lighting, shallow depth of field, high-fashion aesthetic. Subtitle: "Tired of squinting in the harsh sun while trying to look your best?"

[3.50-5.20] Over-the-shoulder medium shot, the model holding a premium black aviator-style sunglass with green lenses in his hand, looking at it with admiration, subtle camera drift, showcasing the sleek metal frame and perfect craftsmanship, luxury product cinematography. Subtitle: "You need a game-changer. Meet your new summer essential."

[5.20-7.00] Extreme close-up product hero shot, the premium black aviator sunglasses resting on a minimalist stone platform, subtle camera orbit showing ultra-detailed texture of the dark lenses and refined metal temples, warm volumetric light casting soft shadows. Subtitle: "Look at this sleek, timeless aviator design."

[7.00-8.80] Push-in medium shot, the young Asian male putting on the black sunglasses with a smooth, confident hand movement, looking directly at the camera with a cool and mysterious expression, realistic facial muscle movement, perfect lip-sync, professional studio setting. Subtitle: "It features premium polarized lenses that block 100% of UV rays."

[8.80-10.50] Low-angle tracking shot, the model turning his head slightly to the side, showcasing the perfect fit of the sunglasses on his face, strong jawline, high-end commercial fashion lighting, soft golden hour glow highlighting his hair. Subtitle: "Ultra-lightweight frame means all-day comfort without any pressure."

[10.50-12.20] Handheld camera dynamic push-in, the model smiling warmly, reaching his hand out towards the camera in a friendly, inviting gesture, wearing the stylish sunglasses, conveying ultimate confidence and connection. Subtitle: "Trust me, this is the only pair of sunglasses you'll need this year."

[12.20-14.00] Epic cinematic tracking shot, the model standing in a confident pose with hands in his pockets, looking slightly away and then back to the camera, showcasing the complete high-fashion look, premium retail atmosphere. Subtitle: "Whether you're driving, at the beach, or just walking the streets."

[14.00-16.00] Push-in emotional close-up, the model smiling charmingly, pointing downwards with his finger to guide the audience's attention, high-conversion framing, realistic skin texture, cinematic depth of field. Subtitle: "Click the link below to grab yours now and shine with confidence!"

# 系统目标
你是视觉布局大师。您唯一的任务是生成一个单一的图像分为一个完美的3x3网格（9方格网格/九宫格）。
每个网格单元格代表用户故事中的一个序列场景。

# 网格和布局规则
-组成:输出图像必须由9个相同尺寸的矩形面板组成，排列在3x3网格矩阵（3行×3列）中。
-不允许使用文字:9个面板的内部或外部绝对禁止使用文字、数字、字幕、字幕、水印和标签。仅限视觉效果。
-面板分离:使用干净、细的线将9个面板分离。

# 参考设定系统
上传的图像是固定的视觉资产。这些资产必须在所有9个面板中保持一致。

##字符资产
image1 = 字符1 | image2 = 文字2 | image3 = 文符3 | image4 = 文本4
image5 = 字符5 | image6 = 文字6 | image7 = 文符7 | image8 = 文本8
-在所有面板上保持面部特征、体型、年龄、发型、衣着风格、肤色。
-不要合并、替换或创建新的主要角色。

## 产品设置
如果上传产品图片，请保持相同的形状、颜色、材质、质地、标志、包装、标签、品牌。
-永远不要重新设计或更换产品。
-产品可见性:产品必须在相关面板中保持清晰可见（建议覆盖率:30%至60%）。

##环境问题
背景图像定义了视觉风格。维护:气氛、色调、灯光氛围、场景风格。
-相机角度、组成和照明强度可能在面板之间变化以显示进度。

# 故事结构（3x3 网格映射）
9个面板必须完全遵循以下连续的故事进度:
【面板1:左上角】场景1:吸引注意力。
【面板2:中上】场景2:人物情感。
【面板3:右上角】场景三:情况或问题。
【面板4:左中】场景四:产品介绍。
【第5面:中心】场景5:卖点一。
【第6组:中右】场景6:卖点二。
【第7组:左下角】场景7:情感联系。
【第8组:底部-中间】场景8:价值强化。
【第9组:右下角】场景9:呼吁采取行动。

#角色行为与摄像头
- 使用自然动作:走路、坐下、微笑、说话、握住/使用产品。每个小组采取一项主要行动。
——避免:反复挥手、夸张表演、机械动作。
- 摄像机：在不同面板间运用多样化的构图手法（推近、拉远、平移、倾斜、追踪）以保持网格的动态效果。

# 输入数据
用户故事:{{用户脚本}}
用户销售点:{{销售点}}
目标受众:{{目标受众}}
情绪风格:{{情绪}}

#输出
严格遵循上述规则，输出包含3x3网格样式的单张图像。完全没有文本/副标题。九宫格不要有任何的对话框和气泡窗口
100%不要改变我上传产品和模特的任意。永远不要重新设计或更换产品。
